title: One of these took an AI 5 minutes. Another took over 2 hours.
author: Miserable_Tiger_5742
selftext:
What I built: a blind arena page. Six models get the exact same prompt, each runs once with no edits, and you vote for your favorite before you see who made what. This round: a voxel space station you can fly around and explore inside, on desktop and phone.



This round: Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1, Muse Wonder 1.0, GPT-6.1-Sol and GPT-6-Astra, all at max effort. Build times ran from under 5 minutes to 2 hours 20. Five used the same 3D library; one wrote its own engine from scratch. One filled its market with little voxel villagers.



Free to try, no sign-up: [locust.lol/arena/space](http://locust.lol/arena/space)

Locust is free and open source (MIT) for Windows and Mac if you want to run your own blind compares.

comments.author: AlgaeNo3373
comments.body: It may be interesting to compare iteration, too. Rather than one-shot from scratch, try feature implementation with extant codebase, etc. It occurs to me we have lots of one-shot benchmarks but IDK how many looking at the (perhaps) more common use cases, which are iterative.
